glossary.title: Glossary
glossary.intro: The words of candombe and the Llamadas, to make sense of what goes by in the street.

candombe.text: Afro-Uruguayan drum music and dance, born in Montevideo. UNESCO Intangible Cultural Heritage since 2009.

llamada.text: The drum call that once summoned players from one neighbourhood to another. Today, also the parade itself.

comparsa.text: A candombe group: drummers, dancers and traditional characters.

chico.text: The smallest, highest-pitched drum. It keeps a steady pulse.

repique.text: The mid-sized drum. It improvises and “talks” to the others.

piano.text: The largest, deepest drum. It lays down the base.

templar.text: Tuning the drums by warming the drumheads at a fire before setting off.

madera.text: The stick tapped on the side of the drum, marking the basic pattern.

toque.text: Each neighbourhood's playing style. The traditional ones are Cuareim, Ansina and Cordón.

cuerpoDeBaile.text: The dancers who go ahead of the drums.

mamaVieja.text: A character: the matriarch, in a full dress, with a fan and a parasol.

gramillero.text: A character: the old healer, white-bearded, with a cane and a case of herbs. He dances with a tremble.

escobero.text: A character: he juggles a small broom and clears the way for the comparsa.

vedette.text: The lead dancer, in feathers and sequins.

estandarte.text: The banner bearing the comparsa's name. It leads the way.

banderas.text: Large flags in the comparsa's colours, waved at the front.

medialunaYEstrella.text: The crescent and star emblems carried on tall poles at the front of the comparsa.

about.title: About
about.open: About Carnavalero, privacy and your data

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.summary: Carnavalero doesn't ask for your name, email or sign-up. Your location is used only for “Near me” and the map, when you ask for it: it is checked on the spot to work out distances and is never stored.

data.title: Your data
data.what: If you follow a group, we keep an anonymous session with the groups you follow and, if you turned on notifications, this phone's identifier to send them and its language. Nothing else.
data.confirmBody: The groups you follow are deleted, this phone stops getting notifications and your anonymous session is closed. This can't be undone.
data.error: We couldn't delete your data. Check your connection and try again.

credits.title: Credits
credits.data: Carnival information comes from public sources: DAECPU, the Montevideo city government and the press. Carnavalero is not an official app.
